title: Persepolis
standfirst: Ceremonial capital of the Achaemenid Empire; inscribed by UNESCO in 1979.

body.text: Inscribed on the UNESCO World Heritage List in 1979[@unesco114].
Venue for part of the October 1971 celebrations of 2,500 years of the Iranian monarchy; they opened on 12 October at the tomb of Cyrus at Pasargadae[@hemmati2015; @lacma-abbas1971; @loc19].
